title: R' Elazar bar Malai

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 139a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.139a.10), speaking in the name of Resh Lakish.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbi Eliezer ben Malai, speaking in Resh Lakish’s name. Hyman’s heading gives R’ Elazar bar Malai.
